label: Independent of a bearer: an item the bearer neither contains nor produces
definition: Independent Contains Produces b e: the bearer b neither contains nor produces the item e. Examples: on Platonism, a Form that a demiurge contemplates; on Leslie-type axiarchism, an abstract value-fact whose requiredness is creatively effective. Non-examples: an idea in the bearer; a product of the bearer. Defined as the complement of containment and production, so that with excluded middle every item is contained, produced or independent.
